# Test fixtures (dev only)

Small apps for the script tests in `tests/run.mjs`. They are never benchmark cases.
Their source has no comments on purpose: an audit that reads the source must not be told where the problems are.

| Fixture | Planted for |
|---|---|
| `mini-app` | walk.mjs (a link hidden on phone) and crawl.mjs label drift ("Start order" and "Order now" go to one place) |
| `visual-app` | visual.mjs: a sentence pill, 6 pills on one card, a date shifted 18px, dates and buttons at different heights in a row, an 84px gap in cards, a square menu among 12px corners, a menu covered by a fixed composer, "Saved 12" over an empty page, tall plan cards whose only action ("View details") sits under 17 pieces of text with 9 small labels, and a 1.2 second loading state that says "Nothing here yet" (tests that pages settle first) |
| `gated-app` | crawl.mjs login wall and --session, login.mjs (with ?auto it signs itself in after 1 second) |
| `rotating-app/server.mjs` | Staying signed in: a small server that swaps its sign-in token on every refresh, so an old token gets 401. `--profile` keeps working there and `--session` alone must fail with "The app signed us out". With `refuseHeadless` it also turns headless browsers away (the off-screen window retry). With `refreshDelay` it answers the refresh slowly, like a real server: a script that loads the next page before the answer is back loses the token (`stats.refresh_lost`). `expire()` ends the sign-in mid-run |
| `phone-app` | visual.mjs clipped text: a reply footer that is cut off at 390 and fine at 1280. Also holds what must not be flagged: long chat titles shortened in a list of links, a row of buttons that scrolls sideways, a code block, and a label only screen readers see |
| `results-app` | samples.mjs: a list of 4 past chats. One holds a "Click to load image" placeholder and a broken image (2 leads), one holds only working images (no lead), two are text only (not opened when 2 are asked for) |
| `use-app` | explore.mjs --use and walk.mjs owner-approved steps. A "+" menu with 3 switches: 2 add a chip to the message box, 1 does not. A checkbox on the page. Sending a message adds a reply with a broken image, 2 unnamed icon buttons and a footer that is cut off at 390. The page tells the test server about every flip and every message, so the test can prove nothing was flipped without `--use` and only one message was sent |
| `owner-rules-app` | owner-rules.mjs and the gate: a `DESIGN.md` with one rule the app breaks (cards 16px apart; they sit 28px apart) and one decision the app follows on purpose (a blunt greeting), a `CHANGELOG.md` that repeats the decision, and `current-complaints.md`, which must never be opened |
| `drift-app` | consistency.mjs component drift: 2 pages with the same text input, primary button and cards, and one search box that has a different corner radius and background (exactly 1 lead) |
| `shift-app` | Layout shift and reduced motion: a tall notice is inserted 0.7 seconds after the page loads (visual.mjs layout-shift lead), and the menu slides in even when the browser asks for reduced motion (explore.mjs reduced-motion lead) |
| `landing-app/server.mjs` | Sign-in from one file: a public page that never links to `/app`, which only opens after sign-in. `login.mjs --audit` writes `signin.json` with where the app landed, and `crawl.mjs --audit` gets into `/app` with no other sign-in flag. The public page shows "Sign in", so `login.mjs` must not save it as signed in |
| `button-cards-app` | samples.mjs, items opened through buttons: 3 project cards with no links. "View" opens a dialog, "Open" shows a panel, "Review" does nothing (1 lead). Every card also has an "Edit" button that must never be clicked. The page tells the test server about every click |
| `checks-app` | The 5 page checks added in 0.8, one page per check, each triggering its check exactly once: `template.html` (a title with unfilled slots), `faint-icon.html` (3 light gray icon buttons on white, 1 dark one), `overflow.html` (chips that run out of their card), `duplicate.html` (one summary in two sections), `duplicate-nav.html` ("Calendar" in the side navigation and as a tab), `stacked.html` (tabs on one row, search and sort on the next, above one list). `overflow-small.html` (added in 0.9) holds a chip 6px outside a 358px card, which is what a different font does: it must not be flagged. `clean.html` holds the look-alikes that must not be flagged: slots inside code, a text area and an input, a stage note in brackets, a "TODO" heading, a disabled button's faint icon, an icon over a gradient, a small corner badge placed outside its card on purpose, two cards with the same description, a footer that repeats the top navigation, a breadcrumb, and one row of controls |
| `marker-app` | explore.mjs markers with no filter: a list of 4 notes, each with a star button. `index.html` has the tabs All and Recent, so nothing shows only the starred notes (1 `marker-no-filter` lead). `with-filter.html` adds a "Favorites" tab (no lead). The page tells the test server about every star click: there must be none |
| `lifecycle-app` | Item lifecycles: 5 post cards in 5 states (Editing, Rendering, Ready, Posted, Failed) that all offer the same two buttons, Publish and Schedule. visual.mjs lists the states under "Item states seen", and the gate then needs an Item lifecycles row for every state |
| `create-app` | explore.mjs on a live app: a plain "Create" button that adds a list item (held: "could create an item"), an "Add" button with `aria-haspopup` that opens a menu (opened), and a "New folder" link to a new page (followed). The page tells the test server about every click, so the test can prove "Create" was not pressed until the owner's allowed list names it |
| `back-app` | explore.mjs, back goes back: Home and Reports both link to Settings. In `index.html` the Settings back arrow always goes to Reports (1 `back-goes-elsewhere` lead that names the 3 pages, with the route from Reports shown as right). In `good.html` the arrow has no name and goes back (no lead, and it must still be found as a back control) |
| `tabs-app` | explore.mjs, sibling tabs: `index.html` has 3 tabs, and one adds a back arrow that pushes the content down 40px, next to a sidebar (1 `tab-shift` and 1 `tab-chrome-differs` lead). `same.html` has 3 identical tabs (no lead). `pages.html` has 3 sub-pages of one section that link to each other, and one has no page title (1 `tab-chrome-differs` lead) |
| `craft-app` | The page checks added in 0.9. `border.html`: a dark form whose input, dropdown and outline button are bordered #333533 on #2A2C29 (1 `faint-border` lead). `border-filled.html`: the same input with a contrasting fill (no lead). `border-light.html`: ordinary light gray borders on white (no lead). `padding.html`: 4 cards at 16px padding and 1 at 4px (1 `tight-padding` lead). `padding-same.html`: 5 cards at 16px (no lead) |
| `layers-app` | visual.mjs, sticky and fixed layers: a long chat page. In `index.html` the sticky top bar and the fixed message box have no background (2 `see-through-layer` leads, each with a screenshot taken while content is under the layer). In `solid.html` both are solid (no lead) |
| `options-app` | explore.mjs, options that vanish: a theme switcher showing System, Light and Dark. `index.html`: a row of 3 buttons that drops System after one click (1 `option-vanished` lead). `keeps.html`: keeps all 3 (no lead, and it ends on System). `cycle.html`: one button that steps through the themes and never comes back to System (1 lead). `menu.html`: a menu that keeps all 3 (no lead). The page tells the test server about every pick, so the test can prove nothing is picked signed in without `--use` |
| `dup-app` | explore.mjs, duplicate controls by what they open: a "Model: Auto" button in the message box and an "Auto (free)" button in the top bar open lists with 5 of 6 models in common (1 `duplicate-on-screen` lead). In `differ.html` the top button opens a sort menu (no lead). Both pages hold a table whose rows each open the same menu, which is not a duplicate |
| `labels-app` | explore.mjs, fields with no visible label. `index.html`: a sign-in form with floating labels that stay in view while typing (no lead). `vanishing.html`: labels that go away once something is typed (1 `unlabeled-field` lead). `placeholder.html`: only a hint inside each box (1 lead). `profile.html`: a profile form with hints only, which must not be typed into on a live app (1 lead, 0 characters typed). The page tells the test server about every character typed and every submit: there must be no submit |
| `rail-app` | explore.mjs, a rail that opens on hover: 3 icon-only buttons in a rail in the top-left corner. In `index.html` hovering the rail shows their text labels (no `no-tooltip` lead). `second.html` is a second page with the same rail and other names: its icons must still be seen as icons, which fails when the pointer is left resting on the rail. In `bare.html` nothing shows (3 leads) |
| `switch-app` | explore.mjs --use, switches turned back: 5 switches on one page. 3 turn back when clicked again, "Live preview" only resets when the page loads again (back after reload), "Beta layout" stays on for good (not back). With 0.8 only the first switch was turned back |
| `dialog-app` | Dialog dismissal: a "What's new" dialog covers the page on load. With `?mode=escape` Escape closes it, with `?mode=x` only the close (X) button and "Got it" do, with `?mode=ok` only "Got it" does. The page tells the test server how it was closed, so the test can prove the order: Escape, then X, then "Got it" |
